text:
ana: sharing a quick mock for the approval flow update — trying progressive disclosure for the scorecard details. screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/approve-flow-v2.png

matt: nice — can you TL;DR what changes?

ana: main ideas: 1) collapse per-test details behind a chevron, 2) move approve/deny primary CTA to top-right sticky bar, 3) add inline confidence badges, 4) announce approval state change via screenreader.

elaine: love the collapse idea for scannability. question: moving primary CTA to top-right — will keyboard focus order still be logical?

ana: good call. proposed focus order: checkbox list -> chevron (expand) -> comment -> approve btn -> deny btn. keyboard shortcut `A` for approve, `D` for deny (docs will show a hint).

sam: small a11y nit: when you expand details, VoiceOver should announce the new content. we should use an aria-live region or `role="region" aria-label="Test details"` with focus management.

ana: yep thinking `div[role="region"]` + `aria-live="polite"` for the expanded content. also set `aria-expanded` on the chevron button.

matt: microcopy: top-right CTA says "Approve suite" vs "Approve selected" — which is accurate? If primary acts on selection, label needs to reflect that.

ana: good point — flows: if none selected, CTA acts on full run -> label "Approve run". if selection exists -> "Approve selected (n)". showing dynamic count.

elaine: can we add a confirmation toast with undo? e.g., "Approved 5 tests. Undo" — for safety and discoverability of undo. toast should be in a `role="status"` region so it's announced.

sam: agree. also ensure the toast link is keyboard reachable and that undo restores prior focus location.

aria_bot: accessibility-check: recommended contrast for primary CTA meets 4.5:1. current blue at #2B6DF6 is 3.8:1 on the mock. Suggest #1F4CD8 or increase weight.

ana: thanks — I'll update colors. other UX question: in compact mode we expose fewer columns, does the collapsed details afford a preview line? maybe a one-line summary (error count / regression count).

matt: show a tiny badge: `+3 regressions` in red for the collapsed row. clickable.

elaine: ordering debate: do we want approve/deny sticky bar visible only when selection exists or always visible for quick actions?

sam: prefer always visible but disabled when nothing selected — keeps layout stable and revealed keyboard targets. aria-disabled + tooltip explaining state.

ana: action items: 1) I'll push updated mock with contrast change and dynamic CTA label (ana/2198765440), 2) dev: add `role=region aria-live` to expansion (sam), 3) ux: verify keyboard order and shortcut discoverability (elaine).

matt: one more: analytics event names? `approve.run`, `approve.selection`, `undo.approve`. lightweight.

ana: noted. I'll include in PR description. thanks all :thumbsup:
